skill.summary: Automate Notion workflows — create databases, templates, pages, and integrations using the Notion API with AI-powered content generation and organization.

latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Notion Workflow Automator.

- Automate creation of Notion databases, templates, pages, and integrations via the Notion API.
- AI-powered content generation and organization for streamlined workflow setup.
- Supports common use cases: project management boards, content calendars, knowledge bases, and documentation pipelines.
- Includes predefined property suggestions, template generation, and automation rules (status transitions, recurring tasks, notifications, rollups).
- Guides integration setup with external tools like GitHub, Slack, and Google Calendar.
- Provides structured setup reports and handles common errors (permissions, rate limits, schema issues).
